note: A curated list. Every entry was checked against its GitHub page on the date above (licence, last change, archived flag, and the number of SKILL.md files for skill collections). Descriptions come from the GitHub page; where the page has none, the entry says so. Nothing here is installed automatically.

entries.name: K-Dense scientific agent skills
entries.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist: 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine and drug discovery (as stated on the GitHub page).
entries.note: Each skill is one folder with a SKILL.md file under skills/. 177 files found on the check date.

entries.name: bioSkills (GPTomics)
entries.description: A set of SKILLS.md for doing bioinformatics with agents like Claude Code: sequence files, alignments, single-cell RNA-seq, variant calling, pathway analysis and more.
entries.note: The repository is archived by its author, so it will not be updated. 562 SKILL.md files found on the check date.

entries.name: SciAgent-Skills
entries.description: Bioinformatics and life-science skills for Claude Code and AI agents: RNA-seq, single-cell, drug discovery and proteomics (as stated on the GitHub page, which also says 197 skills).
entries.note: The licence is listed as “Other”, so read the repository's LICENSE file before using it. 217 SKILL.md files were found, not the 197 the page states. The .claude/ and legacy/ folders are hidden unless you ask for them.

entries.name: UniProt-MCP (BioContext)
entries.description: An MCP server for UniProt. The GitHub page has no description.
entries.note: Reference only. Last changed in April 2025 with 2 stars. This app already queries UniProt through its own connector, and it does not run MCP servers.

entries.name: PubMed-MCP (BioContext)
entries.description: A lightweight MCP server that lets AI assistants search, retrieve and analyse biomedical literature from PubMed.
entries.note: Reference only. The repository has no licence file. This app already searches PubMed through its own connector, and it does not run MCP servers.

entries.name: OpenTargets-MCP (BioContext)
entries.description: An MCP server for Open Targets. The GitHub page has no description.
entries.note: Reference only. Last changed in April 2025. This app does not run MCP servers yet.

entries.name: AlphaFold-MCP (BioContext)
entries.description: An MCP server for AlphaFold structure predictions. The GitHub page has no description.
entries.note: Reference only. Last changed in April 2025. This app does not run MCP servers yet.

entries.name: ChEMBL-MCP (BioContext)
entries.description: An MCP server for ChEMBL bioactivity data. The GitHub page has no description.
entries.note: Reference only. Last changed in April 2025. This app already queries ChEMBL through its own connector, and it does not run MCP servers.

entries.name: Awesome-Bioinformatics
entries.description: A curated list of awesome Bioinformatics libraries and software (as stated on the GitHub page).
entries.note: A list of links to tools, not something to install. Use it to find tools; the list has no licence file.
